steps.content: The girl finally returns, but she doesn't play with everyone as usual. Instead, she stays by herself, deep in thought.
The little critter trails behind her. It gently rubs against her with its body, as if silently comforting her.

steps.speaker: Love
steps.content: Hey! It's no big deal. No need to be so sad over having writer's block!

steps.speaker: Love
steps.content: I often get stuck when it comes to my radio show, too. I just kind of wing it. Nobody will notice! Hehe.

steps.speaker: Daisy
steps.content: Will it kill you to talk a little less?

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: She... she seems to be crying...
Just as everyone is at a loss, you receive a message from Nightingale.
<color=#fb9259>Nightingale:</color> Chief, how's the mission going?
She awaits your judgment.

options: The target is not currently a threat.
I will capture the target immediately.

steps.content: Glancing at the girl nearby, you don't know if you have the heart to separate her from her hard-found companion.
But at the same time, you know that a crisis is building up right under your nose. You won't have much time.
You reply decisively to your adjutant. But despite what you said, do you really have the heart to take away the little critter from the girl?
You understand that from your position, you have to make brutal decisions sometimes.
In a back alley in Dillywood, some noises rustle from inside a garbage dump. A duck that had been beaten into a coma crawls out.

steps.speaker: Rabbo
steps.content:
Quack quack, quack quack, quack quack... Quack quack quack?
(Obbo, Shobbo, Commander... Where are you?)

steps.speaker: Rabbo
steps.content:
Quack quack? Quack quack?
(Commander? Commander?)
The bearded commander is lying at the entrance of the alley, his face full of bruises. He quacks and moans piteously.

steps.speaker: Commander Duck
steps.content:
Quack quack, quack quack quack quack quack. Quack quack quack quack.
(Rabbo, Operation Stella Hunter now rests upon your wings.)

steps.speaker: Commander Duck
steps.content:
Quack quack quack quack, quack quack quack quack...
(Do not fail... Don't let us down...)

steps.speaker: Rabbo
steps.content:
Quack quack! Quack quack! Quack quack quack?
(Commander! Commander! Sob...)

steps.speaker: Rabbo
steps.content:
Quack quack, quack quack, quack quack quack! Quack quack quack quack!
(Commander, everyone, don't worry! I promise to complete the mission!)

steps.speaker: Rabbo
steps.content:
Quack quack quack quack, quack quack quack quack, quack quack quack!
(I pledge my wings for space-time and the multiverse!)
The little duck with the red scarf fixes his hair and walks confidently out of the alley, brimming with determination.
This is?
A sluggish woman walks into the alley and kicks the ducks on the ground.
Commander Duck and his underlings dissolve into colorful specks, vanishing into the air.
...Has the boundary between the real and imaginary worlds become so blurred already?
The woman pats the script in her hand as she talks and steps out of the alley.
